name: confluent-cloud-provider-integration
description: Guide a user through setting up and validating a Confluent Cloud provider integration, so fully-managed connectors and Tableflow reach cloud provider (CSP) resources via a short-lived assumed identity, not long-term access keys. Covers AWS (IAM AssumeRole), Azure (Entra ID multi-tenant app plus service principal), and Google Cloud (service account impersonation), with state tracking across the Confluent and CSP UIs/CLIs. Use when a user says "set up/create a provider integration", "provider integration for an S3 / DynamoDB / GCS / BigQuery connector", "connect a connector without access keys", "IAM role for a Confluent connector", "Entra ID service principal for Confluent", or asks about provider.integration.id or authentication.method. Do NOT trigger for configuring a connector that already has a working integration, for Confluent RBAC or API-key management, for CDC or Tableflow pipelines end-to-end, or for authoring an agent skill; this skill stops once the integration is created and validated.
